translations.web: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.
translations.bsb: For it is not to angels that He has subjected the world to come, about which we are speaking.
translations.kjv: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
translations.asv: For not unto angels did he subject the world to come, whereof we speak.
